Name: Alex Weight Lift Portrait Fix
Author: Buncisoup
Description:
It bothers me that Alex looks shirtless while weightlifting but when you talk to him, he's clothed.
Just a minor itch. You can live without this mod.

Works on the bathhouse, Alex's house, spouse patio, and probably whereever else that uses the same weightlift workout animation.
Compatible with any portrait-changing or visual-changing mods and any base-game languages.
Might not work if there is a mod somewhere that edit the weightlifting animation dialogue/description (but if there is, they most likely be fixing it anyway)[size=3][b]
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size][spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Extract Alex Weight Lift Portrait Fix into Mods folder
[*]Run the game by running the SMAPI.exe
[/list]
To uninstall this mod, simply remove '[CP] Alex Weight Lift Portrait Fix' folder from 'Mods' folder
[/spoiler]

Shoutout to TrentXV's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4047]CP Alex and Sebastian Fix[/url] which also fixes Sebastian's spouse patio portrait. Give it a download, if you will.

[i]Thank you CondernedApe for making Stardew Valley, Pathoschild for the frameworks and detailed modding guides, and TrentXV for making the mod to fix the similar problem![/i]
